title: HackAlem AI repository study: pseudonymised data and code
description: Pseudonymised dataset, analysis pipeline and paper sources for the study "Agentic AI Under a Five-Hour Deadline: Traces of Coding Agents in 3,649 Hackathon Repositories", based on the 3,649 organiser-created repositories of the HackAlem AI hackathon (Astana, 23 September 2026). Credential findings are included only as aggregates.
